hunks.baseline: While the gers on the grasslands shivered in the cool night wind, heavy with sand, people behind a massive wall ten thousand li away were greeting the morning.
hunks.sol: While a ger on the grasslands shivered in the cool night wind, heavy with sand, people behind a massive wall ten thousand li away were greeting the morning.

hunks.baseline: It was still far too early for sunrise. Darkness surrounded them on every side.
hunks.sol: The sun was still a long way from rising. Darkness surrounded them on every side.

hunks.baseline: Rough hoofbeats shattered the dead of night.
hunks.sol: Rough hoofbeats shattered the silence of the night.

hunks.baseline: More than a hundred messengers passed through the Seven Gates without a single formality. Like the dozens of messenger eagles sent ahead of them, they vanished into the wind, each bound for a different destination.
hunks.sol: Some hundred mounted messengers passed through the Seven Gates without a single formality. Like the dozens of messenger eagles sent ahead of them, they vanished like the wind, each bound for a different destination.

hunks.baseline: And the man who had given all these orders listened as reports came in one after another, his face pale.
hunks.sol: The man who had given all these orders listened, pale-faced, as reports came in one after another.

hunks.baseline: “A report from the Five Tiger Commandery! In accordance with Your Majesty’s command, we are immediately preparing three hundred warships, one hundred thousand naval troops, and the Imperial Guards—”
hunks.sol: “A report from the Five Tiger Commandery! In accordance with Your Majesty’s command, we are immediately mobilizing three hundred warships, one hundred thousand naval troops, and the Imperial Guards—”

hunks.baseline: At the Emperor’s sudden command, every sound around him vanished as if washed away.
hunks.sol: At the Emperor’s sudden word, every sound around him ceased.

hunks.baseline: Those who understood the unspoken command backed away and disappeared with careful steps. Before long, only two people remained in the vast main hall.
hunks.sol: Those who understood the unspoken command backed away and disappeared. Before long, only two people remained in the vast main hall.

hunks.baseline: The Emperor leaned at an angle against the throne and continued.
hunks.sol: The Emperor leaned against the throne and continued.

hunks.baseline: “I expected trouble, but this is beyond what I imagined. I didn’t think they’d move so quickly.”
hunks.sol: “I expected as much, but it’s worse than I thought. I didn’t think they’d move so quickly.”

hunks.baseline: That rebellious faction, whose very name was ominous, was larger than expected—and far more methodical.
hunks.sol: That rebellious faction, whose very name was ominous, was larger than expected—and more methodical, too.

hunks.baseline: Even more so than a religious movement that had once erupted like a grass fire from a distant western land, back when Baek Yeon had served the late Emperor.
hunks.sol: Even more so than the religious movement that had once spread like wildfire from the distant west, back when Baek Yeon had served the late Emperor.

hunks.baseline: “It was more than fifty years ago. That was when the people called the Demonic Cult headed for the Central Plains.”
hunks.sol: “It was more than fifty years ago that those called the Demonic Cult headed for the Central Plains.”

hunks.baseline: Though it had happened long before he was born, everyone knew of the momentous event when no fewer than a hundred thousand so-called heretics set foot in the Central Plains.
hunks.sol: Though it had happened long before he was born, everyone knew of the momentous event when no fewer than a hundred thousand cultists set foot in the Central Plains.

hunks.baseline: Especially because they weren’t merely country bumpkins lured in by sweet words. They were an army armed with unwavering faith and spears and swords.
hunks.sol: They weren’t merely country folk lured in by sweet words. They were an army armed with unwavering faith and blades.

hunks.baseline: “When the Demonic Cult’s momentum reached the heavens, the martial artists of the orthodox factions petitioned the late Emperor. They said the Demonic Cult was a foreign enemy disrupting the Great Nation’s order, and asked him to raise the Imperial Army and order a campaign against them.”
hunks.sol: “When the Demonic Cult’s momentum seemed to reach the heavens, the martial artists of the orthodox faction petitioned the late Emperor. They said the Demonic Cult was a foreign enemy disrupting the Great Nation’s order, and asked him to raise the Imperial Army against them.”

hunks.baseline: “And I know you were the strongest opponent of joining the war.”
hunks.sol: “And I know you opposed joining the war more strongly than anyone.”

hunks.baseline: Here, in this very place, the high ministers of the court had argued fiercely for days. The late Emperor had seriously considered ordering a campaign, but Baek Yeon had pleaded with him so earnestly—more than he had ever seen him do before—that the Emperor finally gave up the idea.
hunks.sol: Here, in this very place, the high ministers of the court had argued fiercely for days. The late Emperor had seriously considered ordering a campaign, but Baek Yeon had pleaded with him more earnestly than ever before, and the Emperor had finally given up the idea.

hunks.baseline: “I think there were two main reasons. The first was that the Demonic Cult feared the Great Nation’s power and wasn’t harming the people. And the second was… Cang Gong.”
hunks.sol: “I think there were two main reasons. First, the Demonic Cult feared the Great Nation’s power and wasn’t harming the people. And second… Cang Gong.”

hunks.baseline: Cang Gong—or rather, the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord—had already been a person of interest back then.
hunks.sol: Cang Gong—or rather, the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord—had already been someone to watch back then.

hunks.baseline: He had simply made the choice that was best for the Emperor and the Great Nation—and, by extension, the people.
hunks.sol: He had simply made the choice he believed was best for the Emperor, the Great Nation, and the people.

hunks.baseline: “It can’t be helped. Many martial artists of the orthodox factions have the people’s trust, so we’d have no grounds to launch a campaign against them. But it would’ve been different if the Demonic Cult had survived.”
hunks.sol: “It’s the truth. Many martial artists of the orthodox faction have the people’s trust, so we’d have no grounds to launch a campaign against them. But it would’ve been different if the Demonic Cult had survived.”

hunks.baseline: But what about a pebble left behind after being smashed and battered again and again?
hunks.sol: But what about a stone left behind after countless blows and collisions?

hunks.baseline: And if that pebble had jagged edges sharp enough to harm the people, Baek Yeon would have taken up his hammer without the slightest hesitation.
hunks.sol: If that stone was sharp enough to harm the people, Baek Yeon would have taken up his hammer without the slightest hesitation.

hunks.baseline: “But if things had gone as you hoped, we wouldn’t have made it to the present day.”
hunks.sol: “But if things had gone as you hoped, we might never have reached this day.”

hunks.baseline: A storm of bloodshed would soon descend—one that would make the Great Faction War seem insignificant.
hunks.sol: A storm of bloodshed would soon descend, one that would dwarf the Great Faction War.

hunks.baseline: The information Jin Taekyung had delivered in the dead of night was an unexpected misfortune. But it was fortunate that they had already made thorough preparations to accomplish their great undertaking.
hunks.sol: The information Jin Taekyung had delivered in the dead of night was an unexpected misfortune. Fortunately, they had already made thorough preparations to accomplish their great undertaking.

hunks.baseline: Hundreds of thousands of troops, the imperial banners flying above them, were waiting for their command.
hunks.sol: Hundreds of thousands of troops, the imperial banners flying above them, were waiting for orders.

hunks.baseline: With a solemn voice, the Emperor slowly rose, his ailing body standing upright.
hunks.sol: Speaking in a solemn voice, the Emperor slowly rose despite his ailing body.

hunks.baseline: He was no longer wearing his white sleeping robe, embroidered with a golden dragon in silk thread. Now, clad in heavy armor, he strode across the hall without hesitation.
hunks.sol: Instead of his white sleeping robe embroidered with a golden dragon, he wore heavy armor. He strode across the hall without hesitation.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “Announce to the entire army that I will personally lead the campaign.”
hunks.sol: “Tell the entire army that I will lead the campaign in person.”

hunks.baseline: But the words Baek Yeon struggled to force out never came.
hunks.sol: But Baek Yeon could get no further.

hunks.baseline: The loyal subject saw the Emperor silently shake his head. All he could do was clench his teeth, his heart heavy.
hunks.sol: Seeing the Emperor silently shake his head, the loyal subject could only clench his teeth, his heart heavy.

hunks.baseline: Just like his own future, brief and shrouded in darkness.
hunks.sol: Like his own future, with so little of it left.

hunks.baseline: And so was the fact that someone had briefly brought his will to live back to life.
hunks.sol: And so was the fact that someone had brought back his will to live, if only for a while.

hunks.baseline: “We should see off a certain insolent rogue who’s leaving before me without keeping his promise to me.”
hunks.sol: “We should see off a certain insolent rogue who’s leaving before me without keeping his promise.”

hunks.baseline: At Hyuk Mujin’s report in my ear, I opened my eyes, which I’d kept tightly shut.
hunks.sol: At Hyuk Mujin’s report, I opened my eyes.

hunks.baseline: The look in his eyes and his expression were unusually grave. They seemed to say everything about how urgently the situation was unfolding.
hunks.sol: His gaze and expression were unusually grave. That alone said how urgent things had become.

hunks.baseline: The distance from here, Zhejiang Province, where the imperial capital stood, to Shanxi Province was a full ten thousand li.
hunks.sol: The distance from here, Zhejiang Province, where the Imperial Capital stood, to Shanxi Province was a full ten thousand li.

hunks.baseline: “Still, the Hebei Peng Family didn’t become one of the Five Great Families for no reason. With that kind of strength, they could beat just about anyone. And they have enough intelligence-gathering power to keep a clear eye on what’s happening not only in Hebei but in Shanxi, too.”
hunks.sol: “Still, the Hebei Peng Family didn’t become one of the Five Great Families for no reason. With that kind of strength, they could beat just about anyone. And their sources are good enough to know exactly what’s happening not only in Hebei but in Shanxi, too.”

hunks.baseline: This completely random conversation was all meant to put me at ease.
hunks.sol: This completely random conversation was meant to put me at ease.

hunks.baseline: *Heh.*
hunks.sol: *Huh.*

hunks.baseline: And just as I swallowed the dry laugh threatening to slip out, someone spoke.
hunks.sol: And just as I swallowed the laugh threatening to slip out, someone spoke.

hunks.baseline: With a breezy voice that didn’t suit him at all, the Emperor laughed aloud. He’d been waiting for me in front of the enormous iron gates.
hunks.sol: The breezy voice didn’t suit him at all. The Emperor, who had been waiting for me in front of the enormous iron gates, laughed aloud.
